skills.name: Heavenly Arrow Barrage
skills.description: Shoots multiple arrows towards enemies like massive rain. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3200% Area Damage  *Enemy Evade Rate -50% (10 sec)

skills.name: Beniyasha, Destroyer of Lands
skills.description: Puts on rouge to transform into Beniyasha. Good effects on allies.  *ATK Speed +300% (7 sec) *ATK +300% (7 sec) *Critical Rate +40% (7 sec) *Critical Damage +300% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Yashahime
abilities.description: Yashahime Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
